report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified and contradicted by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and reservation spans returning 200 with ok results. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. Deployment record only proves version 1.0.0 facts. No evidence establishes a bounded cause; logs were excluded.
missing_evidence: Logs for order/checkout services (ev-...-logs-order was excluded) to confirm or refute checkout errors
Error-rate or 5xx metrics across checkout, payment, inventory services beyond order
Deployment timeline correlating any version change with error onset
Baseline latency/error comparison to substantiate downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion alternatives
